description: Shared, versioned parametrization of geometry types used across CIVITA. Each geometry type defines parameters and a right-handed local coordinate system; numerical parameter values and context-specific identifiers belong to individual experimental or computational records.

global_conventions.geometry_type_references: Consumers reference geometry_type_id and geometry_type_version; the local geometry record independently stores parameter values and any dataset-specific metadata.
global_conventions.reference_system_convention: The origin and positive local axis directions are defined by the reference figure together with the textual definition. All local axes form a right-handed Cartesian system.
global_conventions.versioning_policy: Published geometry type versions are immutable. A change affecting geometric meaning, parametrization, or reference system requires a new version.
global_conventions.reference_figures_note: Figure URLs currently point to main for convenience. For immutable published releases, pin each figure reference to a documentation commit SHA or release tag corresponding to the library version.

reference_system.origin: Corner point indicated in the prism reference figure.
reference_system.x_axis: Longitudinal direction along the prism length.
reference_system.y_axis: Transverse direction along the prism thickness.
reference_system.z_axis: Vertical direction along the prism depth.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Dimension along the local x direction.

parameters.name: thickness
parameters.description: Dimension along the local y direction.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Dimension along the local z direction.

cube.name: cube
cube.description: Cubic specimen defined by one edge length.

reference_system.origin: Corner point indicated in the cube reference figure.
reference_system.y_axis: Direction along the second orthogonal cube edge.
reference_system.z_axis: Direction along the third orthogonal cube edge.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Cube edge length along the local x, y, and z directions.

reference_system.origin: Reference point indicated in the cylinder reference figure.
reference_system.x_axis: Cylinder longitudinal axis along the cylinder length.
reference_system.y_axis: First transverse direction in the circular cross section.
reference_system.z_axis: Second transverse direction in the circular cross section.
reference_system.notes: The diameter is measured in the transverse y-z plane.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Cylinder dimension along the local x direction.

parameters.name: diameter
parameters.description: Diameter of the circular cross section in the local y-z plane.

notched_prism.name: notched_prism
notched_prism.description: Rectangular prismatic specimen containing a notch oriented in the local z direction.

reference_system.origin: Midspan point on the specimen centerline indicated in the notched-prism reference figure.
reference_system.x_axis: Longitudinal direction along the specimen length.
reference_system.y_axis: Transverse direction along the specimen thickness.
reference_system.z_axis: Vertical direction along the specimen depth.
reference_system.notch_convention: The notch is oriented in the local z direction. notch_offset is the signed x-coordinate of the notch centerline relative to midspan.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Dimension along the local x direction.

parameters.name: thickness
parameters.description: Dimension along the local y direction.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Dimension along the local z direction.

parameters.name: notch_offset
parameters.description: Signed x-coordinate of the notch centerline measured from specimen midspan. A value of 0 indicates a centered notch.

parameters.name: notch_depth
parameters.description: Depth of the notch measured along the local z direction from the notched face into the specimen.

parameters.name: notch_width
parameters.description: Opening width of the notch.

parameters.name: notch_tip_radius
parameters.description: Radius at the notch tip.

dogbone.name: dogbone
dogbone.description: Dogbone specimen with enlarged heads, transition regions, and a reduced central region.

reference_system.origin: Reference point indicated in the dogbone reference figure.
reference_system.x_axis: Longitudinal direction along the full specimen length.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Overall specimen length along the local x direction.

parameters.name: dogbone_central_width
parameters.description: Width of the reduced central region.

parameters.name: dogbone_central_length
parameters.description: Length of the reduced central region.

parameters.name: dogbone_thickness
parameters.description: Specimen thickness along the local z direction.

parameters.name: dogbone_head_width
parameters.description: Width of each enlarged head region.

parameters.name: dogbone_head_length
parameters.description: Length of each enlarged head region.

parameters.name: dogbone_transition_length
parameters.description: Longitudinal length of each transition region.

parameters.name: dogbone_transition_width
parameters.description: Width change associated with each transition region.

ell_shape.name: ell_shape
ell_shape.description: L-shaped specimen represented by two orthogonal legs.

reference_system.origin: Upper-left exterior corner on the rear face of the specimen, marked O in the ell-shape reference figure.

parameters.name: thickness
parameters.description: Specimen thickness along the local y direction.

parameters.name: ell_length_1
parameters.description: Length of the first leg as defined in the geometry scheme.

parameters.name: ell_depth_1
parameters.description: Depth of the first leg as defined in the geometry scheme.

parameters.name: ell_length_2
parameters.description: Length of the second leg as defined in the geometry scheme.

parameters.name: ell_depth_2
parameters.description: Depth of the second leg as defined in the geometry scheme.

reference_system.origin: Reference point indicated in the notched-cylinder reference figure.
reference_system.x_axis: Cylinder longitudinal axis along the cylinder length.
reference_system.y_axis: First transverse direction in the circular cross section.
reference_system.z_axis: Second transverse direction in the circular cross section.
reference_system.notes: The diameter is measured in the transverse y-z plane. The notch width is measured along the cylinder axis and the notch depth is measured radially.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Cylinder dimension along the local x direction.

parameters.name: diameter
parameters.description: Diameter of the circular cross section in the local y-z plane.

parameters.name: notch_depth
parameters.description: Radial notch depth.

parameters.name: notch_width
parameters.description: Axial notch width measured along the local x direction.

parameters.name: notch_tip_radius
parameters.description: Radius at the notch tip, when reported.

validation_conventions.parameters: Each geometry instance must supply all parameters marked required for its referenced geometry type. Additional parameters are subject to the versioned type definition.
validation_conventions.numeric_parameters: Parameter values must be finite numbers in the declared units.
validation_conventions.positive_dimensions: Dimensions marked exclusiveMinimum: 0 must be strictly positive. Nonnegative radii may equal zero. Offset parameters may be signed.
validation_conventions.geometric_constraints: Geometric compatibility conditions, such as maximum notch depth, must be enforced by geometry-specific validators. Their formal definitions are to be developed without changing existing parameter semantics.
validation_conventions.local_identifiers: Experimental and computational geometry record identifiers, publication source identifiers, and submission file formats are intentionally outside the scope of this global library.
